company.name: Ola Electric
company.shortDescription: Ola Electric focuses on developing and manufacturing electric vehicles (EVs) and related technologies.
company.description:
Ola Electric Mobility engages in the leasing of electric cars. It offers shared daily mobility and deploys charging and battery swapping networks that focus on the commercial electric vehicle segment to make electric mobility convenient, dependable, and affordable.

Ankit Jain and Anand Shah founded Ola Electric Mobility on May 26, 2017. It has its headquarters in Bengaluru, India.

aiResearchSummary.text: Ola Electric is researching vehicle and battery technologies. Work on a dual pass cooling system for battery pack cooling, a pouch cell holder assembly and battery pack for electric vehicle, and current collector plates for batteries targets thermal and structural management. A unified braking system for vehicles and automatic locking and unlocking of vehicles enhance control, while smart charging recommendations for electric vehicles advance charging intelligence. These efforts span battery design, battery materials, vehicle controls, and charging optimization.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Equity round raised $8,153,320, or 0.4% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
